title: Modelling the options embedded in a German Bauspar contract
summary: An open project, stated as an intention and not yet worked: to model the options a German building-society savings contract contains. It sits between the workshop's rational-exercise treatment of §489 and the behavioural evidence that borrowers do not follow that rule.
notes: The exported project carries a description and no documents. Recorded because an empty project with a clear question is a real position in the corpus, and because it names the gap the Efron bridge proposes to fill. No evidence and no friction: nothing has been done yet, and the record must not suggest otherwise.
